description:
- Font stack in style.css with Japanese system fonts (Hiragino Sans, "Noto Sans JP", system-ui) scoped by :lang(ja) so Han glyphs use Japanese forms.
- Line breaking: line-break: strict; word-break: auto-phrase where supported (falls back gracefully).
- Check buttons, pickers, tabs, and chips for overflow at ~400px width with ja strings; transcripts mixing English and Japanese.
- No letter-spacing or text-transform rules that break CJK.
title: Japanese typography and layout in the phone UI
